justification: Remove TXT: ball versus municipal seat is the substantive semantic substitution; no separate fragmentation, spelling or extraction defect is identified.

Abandoning some populated areas can coexist with an influx into other populated areas. The selected sentence does not exclude the claim's causal migration pattern; the original supports_gold judgment for Refuted was too strong.

The supplied referent is one film, but the title can denote a series. The original justification already acknowledged that alternative. Keep the features and record the unresolved referent rather than categorical support.
In a manner is vague and can have a manor-like reading, but is not grammatically malformed on its own. Replace TXT with the missing warrant for the intended manner/location relation.
Arjit and Arijit can be a tolerated spelling error or different literal names. Apply the same ambiguity policy as Kojol/Kajol rather than silently granting identity tolerance in this success case.

DVD is digital, but a DVD release does not exclude a separate analog optical release. The original flag treated one format as the only format. The supplied text cannot settle the existential claim about any analog release.
Umbrella admits figurative package and literal object readings. Retain lexical ambiguity, removing TXT because an odd but possible metaphor is not a separate extraction defect.
Studio sandwich versus studio album is the substantive semantic substitution. Remove TXT rather than double-counting the same incompatibility as malformed wording.
Remove NUM because neither date nor magnitude decides the initially-won claim; the relevant distinction is initial victory versus later stripping with an implicit subject.
A film-versus-crisis category substitution is a semantic distinction. Remove TXT because the sentence is grammatically well formed and no additional extraction or wording defect is identified.

American politician does not establish all ancestry, citizenship or ethnic identities. Only German lacks a specified identity dimension. The earlier conflict was too categorical; reference interpretation needs context.
Picture game admits broad and narrow semantic readings, but the compound alone is not a separate formatting defect. Retain ambiguity and remove TXT.

Apply the same Kojol/Kajol identity ambiguity as case 38599, irrespective of the opposite frozen label or model outcomes. The previous support judgment favored typo tolerance without a consistent rule.
The life dates indicate death before the recorded occasion. Remove NEG because still alive contains no explicit denial; the contrast is lexical and temporal.

The source gives Rose, not Rosa, and says nothing about who bestowed the name. Retain a plausible name/reference tension, but remove TXT: a different name is an entity mismatch, not malformed wording by itself.

Sixteen differs from fifteen on an exact-total reading, but includes fifteen on an at-least reading. Neither the selected sentence nor the annotation explains the intended cardinality rule. Retain numeric scope ambiguity rather than an unconditional conflict.

The listed 2010 film year is not an explicit production date. Apply the same distinction between a work's year and the date of writing/production used in case 15941, rather than treating it as automatic contradiction.

The claim repeats the opening proposition of the evidence almost verbatim. Retain the apparent REFUTES tension; replace LEX with DIRECT because no distinctive paraphrase or type distinction is required.

The evidence says generally negative reviews, matching the claim under the annotated film referent. Remove NEG and LEX: negative is review valence, not explicit propositional denial, and the wording is directly repeated rather than a substantive paraphrase.
Made for film can mean adapted or broader production. Retain semantic/role ambiguity; remove TXT because the wording alone is not an independent formatting defect.

Under a licence is an administrative relation; under a bridge can be a literal location, which the licence statement does not exclude. Remove TXT and qualify the original categorical Refuted-support assessment.

The sentence says reached Number 6, not peaked at 6 or never reached 8. Chart-peak convention suggests a mismatch, but the literal reading permits both positions. The prior justification imported peak; record the competing readings.
The successor role is unchanged; its filler is Henry IV rather than Louis III, with King of Navarre providing a linked identity. Replace REL with CTX to follow the unchanged-role boundary.
Openly versus closeted is a lexical contrast, not explicit denial. Remove NEG while retaining ordinary reference support under the implicit subject link.

Received eight nominations can be an exact total or an existential lower count within sixteen. The original justification already acknowledged the latter reading; its unconditional conflicts_gold assignment was inconsistent with the ambiguity rule.
Hagan/Hagen admits literal identity and typo-tolerant readings. The birth/death distinction supports Refuted only under the intended-identity reading; use the same spelling policy as other names.

The targeted counterpart 206453 exposed the same Hagan/Hagen spelling-tolerance issue. Apply the common identity policy here too: graduation versus birth supports Refuted only under the intended-person reading; literal identity remains unsettled.
UK chart positions do not establish Billboard appearance. Remove NUM because no numerical comparison decides the claim; the chart entity and omitted Billboard fact are the relevant demands.

Hickman versus Hickam and the missing first name require identity tolerance. Apply the same spelling ambiguity policy across both success and regression groups rather than selecting the reference-favoring reading.
Apply the same Arjit/Arijit spelling ambiguity as case 113297. Literal identity and typo tolerance are not resolved by the frozen Supported label.
Rabbta/Raabta requires an untested spelling-tolerance decision. Keep the matching song facts but mark identity interpretation unresolved consistently across sampled outcomes.

Over 1.8 million and over 18 million are compatible lower bounds. The earlier comparison treated the smaller lower bound as an upper bound. The supplied sentence does not establish or exclude the larger threshold.
Pizzas versus rates is the substantive semantic substitution. Remove TXT so the same odd noun is not also counted as a separate formatting defect.

Created by the named people does not exclude their later destroying a character or writing its destruction. The original interpretation confused different predicates with a contradiction; retain the relation feature and add the missing-warrant flag.
The redirected object changes from messages to birds while the redirect role is unchanged. Replace REL with ENT and remove TXT; the substantive object/type mismatch supplies the feature.

The evidence explicitly says Tourette described symptoms; REFUTES is unchanged. Remove REL: the claim and evidence do not change or distinguish the described relation, so CTX captures the surname/full-name link without an extra role feature.

Remaining in syndication establishes television exposure but does not exclude losing a particular earlier opportunity. The claim leaves that opportunity unspecified. Remove NEG because lost is not explicit denial under the polarity rule.

Papua has several supplied referents and the claim uses past tense without a period or country identity. Present-day province/part descriptions do not settle every historical all-country reading. The original conflict overstated what selected text excludes.

The evidence expressly identifies Williams as an inmate in California, opposing REFUTES. Replace DIRECT with CTX because the full-name claim relies on the evidence's surname link, matching treatment of other contextual subject links.

The excerpt dates the last of three major storms, not necessarily every windstorm. The unqualified last-storm claim can refer to that salient set or all storms; the prior support assessment suppressed that scope distinction.

Policies do not establish or exclude windows under every possible meaning of implemented. Remove TXT and avoid claiming that one positive predicate automatically excludes the other; retain the substantive lexical/context gap.

The award/year match under an intended Kajol link, but Kojol and the unnamed her leave identity unresolved. Apply the same spelling policy as cases 38599 and 155934; add NUM for the claimed award year.

A magazine is not ordinarily an airing program, but on at 3 pm could be an imprecise availability claim. The passage gives no time; replace categorical Refuted support with the identified reading ambiguity.
Mellila/Melilla requires spelling tolerance or a different literal referent. Treat the identity ambiguity consistently rather than silently correcting the name.
City versus dish supports Refuted only if Mellila is treated as the supplied Melilla. The literal-name alternative is not settled; apply the same identity policy as case 72194.

The sentence gives 3,090,953 members. An exact-total reading conflicts with 953; an existential reading includes that many. As with other bare cardinal counts, the annotation supplies no explicit exactness policy, so retain ambiguity.
One named role does not explicitly exclude an additional unnamed role. Retain the negative-prefix and role demand, but replace the automatic contradiction with an omitted-role assessment.

Ahead versus behind conflicts under the intended person link, but Rafaeli/Refaeli is a spelling or transliteration variation. Add TXT and retain identity uncertainty rather than silently normalizing this case alone.
Codes versus membrane-bearing cells is the substantive semantic type substitution. Remove TXT rather than duplicating that same incompatibility as a separate wording defect.
The tribal-classification role is unchanged, but its value is East rather than North Germanic. Replace REL with CTX because later North African geography is the distractor that must be kept separate.
